product.title: The LeBron Files
product.summary: Five career decisions where each choice narrows the next.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students steer a career through team selection, a contract, endorsements, business investments and a final family decision, with each choice cascading into the options available at the next, ending in a legacy grade.
product.technology: Next.js 16 + React 19 route, with a grade-band toggle

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: The largest of the bonus simulations and fully built. Not deployed, and no student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: No GitHub Pages deployment (404) and no other live URL found. Requires a build to run.
knownBlockers: No deployment — an instructor cannot run it today without building the app.

provenance.evidence: BSC-anythingelse/app/page.tsx: '5 career decision points. Every choice cascades into the next.' A legacy grade is computed from a cumulative score.
